item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 14 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Naujan), #CamarinesSur(Tinambac, SanJose and Goa) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro, CityOfCalapan, Baco), #CamarinesSur(Garchitorena, Presentacion, Caramoan and Lagonoy) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
